Messages.Author: The Nosferatu Stuff
Messages.Body:
Hey folks, in case anyone wants to save some bucks(and who doesnt?) Origins
has opened up 'Early Bird' registration with a special kick. Sign up with a
friend who's never been before, and you get in free! So find a new friend,
and split the badge you have to pay for! For more info:

LSJ, I imagine you will be able to confirm that there will be a national
qualifier tournament there?(I checked your tournament calander but saw
nothing)

See the offer from GAMA:
http://www.originsgames.net/pdfs/OrgPR_EBExposureForm.pdf

In case you are worried that it might not be mega fun, check out some
pictures I took last year:
http://people.mw.mediaone.net/solar-gunman/jyhad_origins_2001.html

Or the info by Jeff on his site:
http://www.thelasombra.com/road/columbus.htm

And if you think it's too early to register, well the offer expires January
10th! Maybe this way Derek can even come! ;)
--
Aaron
The Nosferatu Stuff
